parse.title: Iron Knight (Arsenal)
parse.text:
Overview

Iron Knight (Arsenal) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable from Summons.

Evolving

Iron Knight (Arsenal) can be evolved from Iron Knight with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Iron Knight
x35 Full Power Core
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Arsenal Drones

Iron Knight (Arsenal) can spawn Arsenal Drones every time he takes down 20 enemies (despite showing it is 50). Note that its drones' attacks are not AoE and has 3 hits.

  • His drones will inherit 25% of his DMG, same range, and will have 5.5 SPA. Each individual drone last 30 seconds upon deployment.
  • After Upgrade 6, His drones will inherit 50% of his DMG, 120% of his Range, will last longer and have 4.0 SPA as well. Each individual drone last 1 minute upon deployment.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
